why: owner 26 Nov b71139: the 1.1.6-beta DRAFT again with the pet / action bar taint fix and the recipe miss filter (not published)

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.6-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1

New: a live preview in the settings window
- A new column on the left of the settings window and an eye button next to every setting with something to see: one click draws a sample in the game's own look (zone text, map label, NPC tooltip, quest tracker, quest window, a REAL spell tooltip, the character line, NPC talk, chat, system lines, red alerts, the game's windows, the game font, the name colours).
- Switch a setting and the sample changes at once; the English original is shown under it.

New: the game's own windows in Persian
- The game menu, character (stats, reputation, skills, honour), bags and bank, the spellbook tabs, friends / who / guild / raid, mail, trade, merchant, auction house, trainers, loot and the group finder: about 430 texts.
- Switch: General > the game's windows (on by default). Off puts every English text back at once.
- Safe for the action bars: the game's own texts are never overwritten, only what a window shows; secure buttons are never touched and nothing changes during combat.

Fixed
- Pet bar / action bar 'Interface action blocked' in combat: the addon no longer calls the game's own quest tracker, nameplate or window-panel functions (they moved the bar layout into addon code).
- Profession recipe tooltips (Reagents, Equip, Use, the made item) are no longer counted as missing translations: items stay English for now.
- Switching NPC names off puts the English target-frame and nameplate name back at once.

Settings
- The panel is ordered by topic: General, Quests (with the quest tracker and Questie), Map and zones, NPCs and talk, Chat and messages, Spells and talents, Font sizes, Colours, Profiles, Status, About.
- The NPC talk switch left the Quests page. Quest titles in the gossip window now follow the quest-title switch.

New Persian
- 73 NPC talk lines that many NPCs share (trainers, flight masters, vendors, festivals).
